title: Paella Paella with Portuguese Sausage and Burrata
description: A twist on traditional paella, featuring Portuguese sausage and creamy burrata cheese.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large paella pan over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped Portuguese sausage and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the diced tomato and cook until the liquid has evaporated, about 5 minutes.
Add the uncooked paella rice and stir to combine with the sausage and tomato mixture.
Add the chicken broth and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
Stir in the crumbled burrata cheese and cook until melted and creamy.
Sprinkle with sliced almonds and serve hot.
Garnish with lemon wedges and additional burrata cheese, if desired.
